source.review_rationale: Reread actual N1 PDF pages 2-6 and 8. Section 2 states the general linear regression model and regularity conditions; Section 3.1 distinguishes independent heteroskedastic errors; Section 3.2 states the HAC dependence, weighting and ordering framework. The article discusses asymptotic justification and finite-sample corrections, not calibration for personal training. The final personal-task limitation is a bounded applicability interpretation, not a source claim that HC/HAC methods can never be useful for training data. Continuous paragraph groups retain the conditions missing from isolated PDF lines; no formulas or table values are activated.

functional_gap.new_user_benefit: Explains why ordinary regression uncertainty needs assumption checks and how HC differs from HAC when errors vary or correlate over time. It fills a source-explanation gap without activating the matrix model-inference capabilities.
